title: LinoRoute 连接配置
description: 填写远程 MCP 地址和你的 LinoRoute API Key。凭证保存在本机，不经过 WorkBuddy 云端，只会通过 HTTPS 发送到你填写的 MCP 服务。
description_en: Enter the remote MCP URL and your LinoRoute API key. WorkBuddy stores the credential locally; it is not sent through WorkBuddy cloud and is sent only over HTTPS to the MCP service you choose.
docLabel: 打开 LinoRoute 获取 API Key
docLabel_en: Open LinoRoute to get an API key

fields.label: 远程 MCP 地址
fields.description: 必须是 HTTPS 的 /mcp 地址；如果使用私有部署，请替换为你的域名。
fields.description_en: Use an HTTPS /mcp endpoint. Replace it with your private deployment hostname if needed.

fields.label: LinoRoute API Key
fields.description: 使用你自己的额度调用；不要把 Key 写入 Skill、GitHub 或聊天内容。
fields.description_en: Calls use your own balance. Never put the key in a Skill, GitHub, or chat message.
